name: Halothane
summary: A powerful inhalant anaesthetic generally used in a medical setting to induce unconsciousness as a supplement with ketamine or fentanyl.

pharmacology.text: The exact mechanism of the action of general anaesthetics has not been delineated. Halothane activates GABAA and glycine receptors. It also acts as an NMDA receptor antagonist, inhibits nACh and voltage-gated sodium channels, and activates 5-HT3 and twin-pore K+ channels. It does not affect the AMPA or kainate receptors.

uses.text: Halothane (bromochlorotrifluoroethane), sold under the brand name Fluothane among others, is a halocarbon with the chemical formula CF3CHBrCl. It is used as a general anaesthetic given by inhalation. It can be used to induce or maintain anaesthesia.

sideEffects.text: Side effects include an irregular heartbeat, respiratory depression, and hepatotoxicity.

summaryZh: 氟烷以商品名稱Fluothane於市場上銷售，是一種全身麻醉藥，可用於誘導以及維持個體於麻醉狀態。此藥物的優點之一是不會增加唾液分泌，這種特性對於難以插管的患者尤其有用。
summaryZhHans: 氟烷以商品名称Fluothane于市场上销售，是一种全身麻醉药，可用于诱导以及维持个体于麻醉状态。此药物的优点之一是不会增加唾液分泌，这种特性对于难以插管的患者尤其有用。

fact.en: Halothane was first made in 1951 by the British chemist Charles Suckling at ICI. Unlike ether, it did not catch fire, which made it a huge step forward for anaesthesia.
fact.zh: 氟烷由英國化學家 Charles Suckling 於 1951 年在 ICI 首次合成。它不像乙醚那樣易燃，因此是麻醉史上的一大進步。
